Name: JP's NPC Showcase
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=6][center][b][i][color=#00ff00][u]NPC Showcase[/u][/color][/i][/b][/center][/size]

[color=#ff00ff][size=5][b][i]Now you can demonstrate your NPCs without resorting to external tools to make GIFs and other formats. [/i][/b][/size][/color]


[size=3]This simple mod allows you to clone your NPCs. To do so, press the [color=#ffff00][b]“K” key[/b][/color] (configurable in GMCM to any other key or key combination) to open the clone creation menu. 
After selecting your NPC, it will appear below your character, and when you click on it, a small menu will open where you can command it to do two things: stand in a fixed position or perform an animation. 
[/size][size=3][color=#00ffff][b]Both formats require the animation index number (the character tilesheet), which starts at the top left with the number 0 and increases to the right by 1 for each sprite. [/b][/color]
[/size][b]The animation format allows you to enter several indexes in [color=#00ffff]index time (ms) format[/color] (0 500 1 500, for example).[/b]
[color=#00ff00][size=4][b][i]To access the different outfits that the NPC may have, you must manually fulfill the conditions (for example, for winter outfits, you must be in winter).[/i][/b][/size][/color]
[i][b][color=#ff0000][size=3][u]When you are finished, be sure to delete all clones.[/u][/size][/color][/b][/i]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Pr8gBRwv/NPCShowcase.gif[/img]﻿

[i][color=#00ff00][size=5][b]That's it, GMCM is very necessary in this mod in order to configure the mod according to your preferences. You will find detailed information in each option.[/b] [/size][/color][/i]


[i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.
